about: Held-out AI polish cases (bench/suite.py polish run --cases-file polish_cases_holdout.json): kept out of prompt tuning, so a prompt tuned on polish_cases.json can be checked on dictations it wasn't shaped by. Same format and rules. The hand-written ones were written after the first prompt experiments; the hard ones come from the same real dictations as the main set's. Corrections use an explicit marker (哦不对): "A不是B" reads as a contrast (A, not B), not a correction, so cases written that way were ambiguous and were reworded.
